facts.value: You must have one set of transcripts from every college and university from which you earned a bachelor’s degree or higher sent to ASU.

facts.value: Official transcripts must be sent directly to ASU Admission Services from the issuing institution's records office either by mail or through a secured electronic transcript service.

facts.value: ASU accepts unofficial transcripts as part of the application, but if you are admitted, you will be required to send official transcripts to the university.

facts.value: ASU does not accept the GRE® General Test at home.
